paite: Ngai un, Pa hon itna thupi hi na tel e! Pathian tate chih a i om; huai mah i hihna uh ahi hi. Hiai khawng ziak in khovel in ahon thei kei hi, amah atheih louh ziak in.
heading: Pathian Tate
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

paite: Deihtakte aw, tu'n ah Pathian tate i hi ua, bangchi in ahia i om ding chih akithei tadih kei hi; amah ahong kilak chiang in, amah bang in i om ding chih bel i thei hi, amah a-om ngeingei bangtak a mu ding i hi ngal ua.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

paite: Amah tung a lametna nei peuhmah amah asiangthou bang in akihihsiangthou hi.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

paite: Kuapeuh thil hihkhial dan ah atalek hi; dan a tatlekna khelhna ahi ngal a.
heading: Pathian Tate Leh Diktatna
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

paite: Amah khelhnate lamang ding in ahong langta chih na thei uhi; amah ah khelhna bangmah a-om kei hi.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

paite: Kuapeuh amah a om gige in thil ahihkhial kei; kuapeuh thil hihkhial in amah amu kei a, amah leng athei kei hi.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

paite: Tate aw, kuamah khem in om kei un. Diktatna hihmi amah adiktat mah bang in adiktat hi.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

paite: Thil hihkhialmi zaw diabol a pawt ahi; diabol in atung a kipan thil ahihkhial hi. Pathian Tapa hong latna pen diabol nasepte ahihmanthat theihna ding in ahi.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

paite: Kuapeuh Pathian a suak in amah a Pathian chi a-om gige ziak in thil ahihkhial kei, Pathian a suak ahih ziak in, thil ahihkhial thei kei hi.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian tate leh diabol tate atheihtheih hi; kuapeuh diktatna hih lou Pathian a suak ahi kei a, a-unau it lou leng Pathian a suak ahi kei hi.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

paite: Atung a kipan thukhah na zak uh i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh chih ahi.
heading: Unau Ki-ittuahna
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

paite: Kain, giloupa a kipan amah unau thatpa bang in om kei ni. Bangziak in ahia athah tak? Amah thilhihte agilou a, a-unau thilhihte adik ziak in ahi.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

paite: Naute aw, khovel in nou ahon huatleh lamdang sa kei un.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

paite: Unaute i it ziak in sihna a kipan in i pawt ua, hinna ah i lutta chih i thei uhi. Kuapeuh itna nei lou sihna ah a-om lai hi.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

paite: Kuapeuh a-unau hua tualthat ahi; tualthatmi tangtawn hinna nei a-om kei uh chih na thei uhi.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

paite: Hiai ah itna bang ahia chih i thei hi, ama'n eite a dia ahinna apiak tak ziak in; en leng unaute a ding in i hinna i piak sam ding ahi.
heading: Itna Latsakna
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in khovel sum nei in, a-unau tasam in mu henla, amah lainat tuan kei taleh Pathian itna amah ah bangchi in a-om dia?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

paite: Naute aw, thu kia in it kei ni, lei kia in leng it sam kei ni, thilhih leh thutak in hi zaw hen.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

paite: Hiai in thutak a suak i hi chih hon theisak a, amah ma ah i lungtang i muangsak thak ding hi.
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

paite: I lungtang in siam louh ahon tansak dek chiang in chihna ahi; Pathian zaw i lungtangte sang in alianzaw a thil bangkim athei hi.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

paite: Deihtakte aw, i lungtang in siam louh ahon tan keileh Pathian lam ah i hangsan hi;
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

paite: athupiakte i zuih ua, amitmuh a thil kipahhuai i hih zel ziak in i nget peuhmah amah a kipan in i mu zel uhi.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

paite: Huan athupiak hiai ahi, a Tapa Jesu Khrist min gingta lehang, ama'n thu ahon piak bang in ki-ittuah chiat lai lehang.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

paite: Athupiakte zuimi amah ah a-om gige a, amah mah leng amah ah a-om gige hi. Huan Kha ahon piak ah amah eimau ah a-om gige chih i thei uhi.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
